title: Continuous voter registration
summary: Register any working day at your constituency's IEBC office. Don't wait for a mass drive — registration closes months before the election.

title: Enhanced mass voter registration drive
summary: IEBC's countrywide push with mobile BVR kits in wards and markets. The easiest chance to register close to home.

title: Voter registration closes
summary: The register closes about six months before election day. After this you cannot register or transfer for the 2027 General Election.

title: Register inspection window
summary: Check your details on the roll and report errors. This is the last chance to fix a wrong polling station or misspelt name.

title: Party primaries season
summary: Parties nominate their candidates for every seat. Party members vote in primaries; independents prepare their papers.

title: Candidate nomination with the IEBC
summary: Every candidate presents nomination papers to the IEBC. The final ballot line-up per seat is known after clearance.

title: Official campaign period begins
summary: Cleared candidates campaign under the Electoral Code of Conduct until 48 hours before election day.

title: Campaigns end
summary: All campaigning must stop 48 hours before polls open. No rallies, adverts or bulk campaign messages beyond this point.

title: Election day
summary: The 2027 General Election: six ballots, one day, polls open 6am to 5pm. The date is fixed by the Constitution (second Tuesday of August).

title: Presidential result declared
summary: The IEBC must declare the presidential result within seven days of election day.
